integrity: All Lie-derivative identities were reconstructed from the vector field and replayed with exact rational arithmetic by the included dependency-free checker. The strict period step uses the classical Wirtinger inequality and its equality characterization. Literature comparisons are statement/implication comparisons; no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns compactly supported invariant probability measures and nonconstant periodic orbits of the classical Michelson flow. It gives no existence, stability, mixing, entropy, or quantitative gap above the strict period floor. The foundational 1986 source predates the recorded day-resolved source but inspected metadata gives only 1986-02; the exact-day field therefore uses the earliest inspected same-object source with a verified day, 2006-12-05, rather than inventing a 1986 day.
title: Exact derivative-energy balance and a strict period floor in the Michelson flow
